text: This woman fell seventy-five floors in an elevator, and survived.
In nineteen forty-five, a bomber lost in the fog flew into the Empire State Building, and damaged an elevator's cables.
Betty Lou Oliver, the injured elevator operator, was put in that car to be taken down. Then its cables snapped.
As it fell, the broken cables piled up at the bottom of the shaft, like a coiled spring.
And the air trapped under the car was squeezed into a cushion.
She was badly hurt, but she lived. It's still the record.
So how does a normal elevator stop a fall? Full video on my channel.
